The three effects ported verbatim: the vehicleId-switch reset effect (L119-124, deps [vehicleId,resetChart,clearTail], also zeroes tailRateRef); the enabled/selection chart-reset effect (L126-129, deps [enabled,chartSignals,resetChart]); the 1 Hz tail-rate counter effect (L131-142) using setInterval/clearInterval — !enabled -> setTailRate(0) + early return, else sum tailRateRef.current each 1000ms then clear, cleanup clearInterval. setInterval/clearInterval/Date/JSON are all available in React Native so this is portable as-is.

handleVehicleUpdate useCallback (L144-259, deps []) ported byte-for-byte: enabledRef guard (L146); the raw->typed {signals,cold,tables,timestamp,vehicle_id} cast (L147-153); the vehicle-scope filter with number!==selected and Number(string)!==selected early returns (L155-161); now=Date.now() and ts = data.timestamp ?? new Date().toISOString() (L163-164). Chart slice (a) (L166-216): per-selected-signal numeric coercion (number passthrough / boolean->1|0 / parseFloat(String)) with Number.isNaN guard, point[sig]=num, hasValue flag, per-signal chartAccRef accumulation; on hasValue the buffer push + chartPointCountRef++ + the rolling-window shift while first.timestamp < ISO cutoff + the throttled flush (>=LIVE_THROTTLE_MS) recomputing setChartData/setChartPointCount and the min/max/avg/count stats over chartAccRef. Tail slice (b) (L218-258): tailMax===0 and tailPaused early returns; the cold[] array branch (name+value objects), the tables object-of-objects branch (column name/value), and the !cold&&!tables signals fallback (skipping timestamp/vehicle_id/ts keys and nested objects); each path increments tailIdRef and pushes {id,timestamp:ts,name,value:String(value),type:detectType(value)}; finally tailRateRef push + setTailEntries newest-first slice(0,tailMax). All pure TS, no DOM.

useRealtimeEvents call (L261-264) is preserved exactly — useLiveSignalStream still calls useRealtimeEvents({enabled, onVehicleUpdate: handleVehicleUpdate}) and destructures { connected }. The return object (L266-278) is ported verbatim: connected, chartData, chartStats, chartPointCount, tailEntries, tailRate, tailPaused, setTailPaused, clearTail, resetChart.

Unavailable browser-only behavior (rule 7): web useRealtimeEvents -> singleton sseManager -> browser EventSource has no native built-in. A native-safe useRealtimeEvents is inlined using the exact EventSource-polyfill-detection pattern already established in apps/native api/sseClient.ts and api/hooks/useAchievementUnlocks.ts (getEventSourceConstructor reads globalThis.EventSource). A module-level singleton (vehicleUpdateListeners + realtimeStateListeners + one realtimeSource) preserves the web 'only ONE SSE connection no matter how many callers' guarantee, the 'vehicle_update' event name, and the /api/v1/events endpoint (apiUrl('/events') -> base + /api/v1/events). connected becomes true on the EventSource 'open' or server 'connected' event and false on 'error'; when no EventSource polyfill is installed the hook stays explicitly disconnected (REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE_REASON exported, mirroring the sibling files' UNAVAILABLE_REASON constants). The vehicle_update payload is JSON.parsed defensively before fan-out, matching how the web sseManager delivers a parsed object to onVehicleUpdate.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only react hooks + the existing apps/native web-parity api/client apiUrl helper (rule 5). Native uses relative imports (no @/ alias), so @/hooks/useRealtimeEvents and @/types/telemetry collapse to the in-file native-safe implementations and ../../../api/client respectively. There is no react-i18next or visual surface in this hook, so i18n/visual intent is N/A. Verified gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) passes, npm run lint -- --quiet passes (0 problems), and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles passes.
